title: Momentum plus PIT qualifying insider purchases
hypothesis: PROPOSED: adding recent point-in-time qualifying insider-purchase activity to medium-term momentum improves BOTH mean daily net return and zero-RF Sharpe versus matched momentum-only on the same historical source-covered common-equity universe, robustly across frozen chronological evaluations.
rationale: Momentum may reflect gradual information incorporation; disclosed insider purchases may supply complementary conviction. Delays, private purchases, selection and costs may remove the incremental information.
expected_effect: Positive paired mean daily net excess return and positive separate zero-RF Sharpe difference; lower drawdown alone is insufficient.
falsification_conditions: Nonpositive paired mean daily net excess return OR nonpositive zero-RF Sharpe difference versus matched momentum-only in frozen out-of-sample evaluation.
Direction disappears under predeclared costs/disclosure delays or is concentrated in one cell, issuer or regime.
Invalid source availability or identity invalidates design, rather than economically falsifying the hypothesis.
confounders: Size, sector, market beta, liquidity and volatility exposures
Nonrandom insider coverage, private P purchases, amendments and disclosure delay
Vendor revisions, source survivorship, unknown exchange/OTC classification and delisting economics
Family/grid selection and human/model historical knowledge
asset_universe: Historical source-covered CS identities with unambiguous effective ticker/date spans and completed valid source prices; no current membership, index, cap, ADV or exchange filter

dynamic_universe.definition: PASS scoped source-rule reconstruction: historically effective unique CS security identity at prior completed session and intended execution; finite positive nominal source price, retain ended histories while active, exclude ambiguous/unknown/non-CS. No current membership, index, exchange, cap or ADV requirement. Completed365-day history and certified insider states define the shared eligible signal universe; insider gate remains false.

permitted_indicators: Locally computed 180/365-calendar-day split-continuous price momentum using only completed bars and splits effective within the lookback. First completed bar on/after elapsed-calendar boundary; cash dividends separate.

Locally reconstructed Distinct Qualifying Insider Purchasers: nonderivative P/A positive-share events, including private purchases; distinct stable owner CIK, firstAvailableAt 30/90-day windows, as-of corrections.
Eligibility/guards only: historical CS identity, completed price, certified signal availability, validity==1 and exact full session key. No additional alpha signal.

costs.slippage_note: Base 0.10% per fill; cash dividends. Proposed local +10/+20-bps absolute traded-notional stresses on both sides, fixed-fill sensitivities rather than native slippage/capacity simulation.

Precomputed disclosed numeric + validity + exact YYYYMMDD session-key guards. Equal ranks/security weights, long only, no leverage.
